segments.sn55.39:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
segments.sn55.39:1.2: Atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena kāḷigodhāya sākiyāniyā nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
segments.sn55.39:1.3: Atha kho kāḷigodhā sākiyānī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho kāḷigodhaṃ sākiyāniṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.sn55.39:2.1: “Catūhi kho, godhe, dhammehi samannāgatā ariyasāvikā sotāpannā hoti avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā.
segments.sn55.39:2.3: Idha, godhe, ariyasāvikā buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatā hoti –
segments.sn55.39:2.4: itipi so bhagavā … pe … satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
segments.sn55.39:2.7: vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati muttacāgā payatapāṇinī [payatapāṇī (sabbattha)3.30 moggallānasuttaṃ oloketabbaṃ] vossaggaratā yācayogā dānasaṃvibhāgaratā.
segments.sn55.39:2.8: Imehi kho, godhe, catūhi dhammehi samannāgatā ariyasāvikā sotāpannā hoti avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā”ti.
segments.sn55.39:3.1: “Yānimāni, bhante, bhagavatā cattāri sotāpattiyaṅgāni desitāni, saṃvijjante te dhammā mayi, ahañca tesu dhammesu sandissāmi.
segments.sn55.39:3.3: itipi so bhagavā … pe … satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
segments.sn55.39:3.6: yaṃ kho pana kiñci kule deyyadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ appaṭivibhattaṃ sīlavantehi kalyāṇadhammehī”ti.
